title: compress_mqtt_sn: add profile-limit precheck after csdw preflight merge
description: Follow-up from emca scope decision: worker-4's fb8e7f4a70 (compress_mqtt_sn buffer-atomic preflight) is on their branch, not yet merged into beads-worker-6. emca added the profile-limit precheck (needed > SCHC_FRAG_MAX_PACKET_SIZE -> Err InvalidPacket, pre-write) to compress_coap/icmpv6_echo/rpl_dio/rpl_dao; compress_mqtt_sn on this tree still has the late mutate-then-check shape and would need the same 4-line profile precheck after fb8e7f4a70's preflight lands (insert after its needed>out.len() check, before out[0]=RULE_MQTT_SN). Also add an over-profile sentinel test mirroring coap_compress_over_profile_leaves_buffer_untouched. Until then the MQTT-SN dispatcher path keeps the documented non-atomic carve-out on the profile-limit error only (BufferTooSmall is already atomic on worker-4's branch).
